layout.quote: One dashboard for the weather, your repos and your feeds.

login.title: Welcome back.
login.lead: Sign in to find your dashboard, your widgets and your connected services.

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Open your first door to a dashboard that gathers weather, GitHub and RSS feeds.
register.devMailHint: Locally without Gmail SMTP, the email lands in Mailpit:

confirm.title: Confirm your account
confirm.lead: Enter the 6-digit code you received by email.
confirm.resent: A new code was sent if the account exists.
confirm.success: Account confirmed — you can now sign in.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your email — you’ll get a 6-digit code.
forgot.failed: Could not send the code. Try again.

reset.title: New password
reset.lead: Enter the code you received and your new password.
reset.success: Password updated — you can sign in.

hero.title: Open the threshold to
hero.lead: Weather, GitHub repos, RSS feeds: Threshold brings your sources together in a single dashboard, which you compose widget by widget and a timer keeps up to date.

services.title: Five doors, ten widgets.
services.lead: Each widget has its own settings: two instances of the same widget can track two cities, two repos or two different feeds.

weather.pitch: Temperature and rain for the cities that matter to you.

github.pitch: Commits and security alerts from your repositories.

rss.pitch: The latest articles from your favorite blogs and media.

finance.pitch: Live exchange rates and crypto prices.

hackernews.pitch: Top stories and search on Hacker News.

steps.title: Four steps, then it runs on its own.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.text: Sign up by email, confirmed before first access.

step2.title: Connect your services
step2.text: Weather is included. GitHub links via OAuth, RSS with a URL.

step3.title: Compose your dashboard
step3.text: Pick a widget, set its parameters and its frequency.

step4.title: Let it run
step4.text: The timer refreshes each widget at its own pace.

preview.title: Your dashboard, for real.
preview.lead: Add, reconfigure, move or delete your widgets. Each one updates at its own frequency.
preview.alt: Preview of the Threshold dashboard with weather, GitHub and RSS widgets

cta.title: Ready to cross the threshold?
cta.lead: Your first widget is three clicks away.

notFound.title: This door doesn’t exist.
notFound.lead: The requested page could not be found or was moved.
